method: Complete important-article census joined by stored immutable IDs to existing saved semantic groups, final editor representative IDs and published story/coverage/evidence IDs. No new semantic matching.
limits: Article pipeline routes, not distinct events, recall or automatic omissions. Missing saved groups do not establish singleton membership or non-admission. Published membership may lack semantic cache confirmation. Social prose and editorial importance are not inferred by ID routing. No historical backfill or provider calls.
